type Mixed = { [key: string]: number } | { [key: number]: string };
type A = Mixed[0];
type B = Mixed['1'];
function mixed(x: Mixed, key: number): void {
  const a = x[0];
  const b = x['1'];
  const c = x[key];
  x[0] = 1;
  console.log(a, b, c);
}
const key = Symbol();
function sym(x: {[key: symbol]: number} | {[key: string]: string}, y: {[key]: string} | {[key: symbol]: number}): void {
  const a = x[key];
  const b = y[key];
  console.log(a, b);
}
function pat(x: {[key: `data-${string}`]: number} | {[key: string]: string}): void {
  const a = x['data-foo'];
  const b = x['data-foo' as 'data-foo' | 'data-bar'];
  console.log(a, b);
}
function noCommonDot(x: {[key: `data${string}`]: number} | {[key: string]: string}): void {
  console.log(x.dataFoo);
}
function missingTuple(x: [number] | [number, string]): void {
  console.log(x[2]);
  console.log(x[-1]);
}
function missingProp(x: {a: string} | {b: string}): void {
  console.log(x['a']);
}
function readonly(x: {readonly [key: string]: number} | {[key: string]: string}): void {
  x['f'] = '';
}
function tupleWrite(x: [number] | [number, string]): void {
  x[1] = 15;
  x[1] = undefined;
}
function symbolWrite(x: {[key: symbol]: string} | {[key: symbol]: number}): void {
  x[key] = true;
}
